inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.open.root
inputs.description: Repository root passed to createPlanning; it must resolve to the root of a Git repository or opening rejects.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.plans.revision
inputs.description: Git commit or other revision used to pin the plan snapshot; it is passed to the planning API and must resolve in the repository.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.createPlan.draft
inputs.description: PlanDraft supplies the plural category, title and goal, plus an optional proposed contract; an omitted contract gives empty input, output and error arrays, and the title must produce a non-empty slug of at most 64 characters.

examples.title: Planning message
examples.goal: Append user or agent messages to a planning thread.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.ensurePlan.unit
inputs.description: Canonical ComponentManifest whose id, kind, title, responsibility and contract seed a plan; an existing plan for the id is returned instead of creating another.

examples.title: Planning message
examples.responsibility: Appends a planning message to its thread.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.addDesign.draft
inputs.description: DesignDraft supplies an entity, prompt, generator, source revision, state, viewport and image bytes, with optional notes, options and revision anchor; visual plans require images while headless plans require notes.

examples.notes: Appends one user or agent message to a planning thread.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.openThread.draft
inputs.description: ThreadDraft identifies an entity and may anchor a thread to a version image, state, viewport and region; a null version creates an unanchored thread.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.messages.entityId
inputs.description: Unit id whose plan is read for the requested thread; the thread must belong to this entity.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.messages.threadId
inputs.description: Generated thread record id used to select messages; it must be present in the entity's plan.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.messages.revision
inputs.description: Git revision at which the entity and its thread are read; it must resolve in the repository.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.appendMessage.draft
inputs.description: MessageDraft supplies entity and thread ids, author, text, mode and optional provider, model and artifact references; a null mode defaults to plan, while change mode requires a current approval for the same version.

examples.author: user
examples.text: The plan needs a clear message example.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.approve.draft
inputs.description: ApprovalDraft binds a version to its exact image hashes and contract hash, with an optional design option; only the latest design and matching images can be approved.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.image.query
inputs.description: PlanImageQuery selects an image by entity, version, SHA-256 and revision, optionally requiring a design option; the image must belong to that entity and version.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.history.entityId
inputs.description: Unit id whose planning history is read at the requested revision.

inputs.name: PlanningFacadeAdapter.history.revision
inputs.description: Git revision used to read the entity's commit history; it must resolve in the repository.

errors.name: Planning repository or delegated operation failure
errors.description: The facade propagates Error rejections from its planning helpers and Git-backed PlanningApi; failures include repository initialization, rejected snapshot paths, unusable plan titles, invalid or missing design, thread and image selections, missing threads, approval mismatches, and history-read failures.
